name: pytest-quick-run
description: Run a pytest function directly without repository-wide test discovery.

commands.title: Pytest Quick Run: Run Test at Cursor
Pytest Quick Run: Debug Test at Cursor

pytestQuickRun.pythonPath.description: Python executable used to invoke pytest. Leave empty to use Python's configured interpreter or python3.

pytestQuickRun.pytestArgs.description: Additional arguments inserted before the pytest target. -s is enabled by default so print() output is shown immediately.

pytestQuickRun.cwd.description: Working directory for pytest. Leave empty to use the workspace root.
